An anniversary card with two teddies and all your memories

A year together is worth more than a quick emoji. This anniversary card opens like a letter, writes your message out slowly, shows your favourite photos through the years as polaroids, and ends with two teddies dancing among the hearts. It is a small, warm way to say you would choose them all over again.

Make a anniversary card · ₹35

Preview it free. You only pay when you love it.

What’s in your anniversary card

  • A love letter in a gold-edged stationery style
  • Your photos “through the years” with captions
  • Two teddies, one for each of you, dancing together
  • Your own song or a soft built-in tune
  • Hearts drifting across a night sky
  • A private link for them to open whenever they like

Message ideas you can borrow

Another year of us, and I would choose you all over again. Thank you for the laughs, the patience and all the little moments.
They say time flies when you are having fun. With you it has been one long adventure. Happy anniversary to my favourite person.
Years from now I want to look back at this day and smile, because I spent it with you.

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹35 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

Can I add photos from different years?

Yes, up to 5 photos with captions such as “2019” or “our first trip”.

Does it work if we are in different cities?

Yes. Send the link on WhatsApp and they open it wherever they are.

Can I edit the card after paying?

A paid card is final, so use the free preview to check the names and spelling first.
